cases.title: First launch, system light: onboarding, no account/sample data/permission prompts
cases.expected: R-ONBOARD: one welcome, no account, no sample, no prompts
cases.actual: Welcome screen (3 claims, Get started, Restore backup), no account/sign-in; no permission dialog at launch or after Get started; no runtime permissions granted (dumpsys). Home reached directly after I've saved it.

cases.title: 24 words shown and readable again later (light)
cases.expected: 24 words once, readable later
cases.actual: 24 word nodes at creation; readable again via Settings > Show recovery key behind a device-credential check (      24 nodes). Not an image: screen is secure. Note: with no device passcode it refuses and asks for one.

cases.title: Empty Home matches AndroidHome board (light)
cases.expected: design/mockups/FirstHome.dc.html (day one): 'Nothing in here yet' + 'Add photos and documents to get started.' header, first-run order, Health 'Connect your health app' medium tile; no sample data
cases.actual: Fresh vault opens on the content springboard (no day-one header or caption; Health is a small 'Connect' tile). Cause: the starter Notes row counts as Content so springboard() is not FirstRun, whereas the board draws the starter inside the day-one layout. Starter note 'Link with [[' is a deliberate ordinary row (starters.rs), not sample data. Lockup, search, settings, tiles and Home/Chat/Backup band otherwise match AndroidHome.

cases.title: 24 words shown and readable again later (dark)

cases.title: Empty Home matches AndroidHomeDark board

Not an onboarding prompt, but it appears on Home without an in-app moment of need (promise: asked at the moment of need) - owner to judge.

cases.title: Blocker 8: Locker guarded export with fresh owner check
cases.expected: plaintext export asks a fresh owner check (PLAN J3 'Take out')
cases.actual: ABSENT-of-defect up to the check: Locker open behind a system credential check; Export page states what leaves (6 items, unencrypted); a confirm 'Write every secret to a file?'; then a fresh 'Confirm it's you' check even though Locker was unlocked a minute earlier. cases.title: Notification Done from shade after process kill
cases.expected: Done from a notification works with the process dead; receipt with Undo
cases.actual: PRESENT/PASS. Reminder 'Early reminder: At the time' explicitly set, due 8:05 PM, process killed by PID (run-as kill -9; am kill left a visible process alive). Alarm was registered (dumpsys: RTC_WAKEUP 20:05:00, window +1m49s, i.e. inexact), arrived ~8:05 with actions Mark as done / Snooze 1 hour / Tomorrow. With the process dead again, Mark as done from the shade posted a receipt 'Task done, <title>' with Undo.

cases.title: Notification Undo survives process death
cases.actual: With the process killed again after Done, tapping Undo on the receipt dismissed it, and the task is open again in Reminders > Today (8:05 PM, reminder Today 8:05 PM).

cases.title: J6-token-lost

cases.title: J3-docs-link-attach
cases.expected: promises.md Connect and Attach: one picker, no Locker; attach file/photo
cases.actual: Docs reader of 'Tahoe packing list' has ABOUT/Add person, Attachments (Add photo, Add file) and LINKED TO (Add link). Picker: 'Sierra' -> 'No match' (Locker item name, Home search finds it); linked person 'Maya Alvarez' -> row + 'Linked' + Undo; Add file attached 'People.vcf (1)' with 'Attachment added'. INCIDENT: on a first attempt typing 'Sierra' into this picker produced an app ANR ('Input dispatching timed out' on key events, evidence docs-anr-picker-typing.jpg); after >30 s I force-stopped and the retry (typed in 3-char chunks) worked. cases.title: J5-alert-cancelled-on-edit
cases.expected: PLAN s6 J5: cancellation when the item is changed or deleted; same rule both platforms
cases.actual: Notifications were blocked (POST_NOTIFICATIONS granted=false); the editor said 'Notifications are off' with Open Settings; Open Settings went to the app's system notification page, I switched it on, returning to the editor the warning cleared (no stale text this time). Task 1 (typed, today 8:25 AM, Early reminder 'At the time'): dumpsys alarm showed RTC_WAKEUP 08:25:00 (inexact window +3m33s); after Move to trash (confirm sheet) the 08:25 alarm was gone and no dev.centraid notification arrived. Task 2 (08:45 AM At the time) edited to 9:45 AM: 08:45 alarm replaced by 09:45 (also after an emulator restart only 09:45 existed, so alarms were re-registered on boot). No alert for either old time. INCIDENTS: (a) app ANR 'Input dispatching timed out' on a tap in the time-picker dial (evidence rem-anr-time-picker.jpg), waited >30s, force-stopped; (b) next launch showed an ANR dialog 'failed to complete startup'; Wait let it come up; (c) later a system ANR with emulator rendering stalls (surfaceflinger/composer ~60% CPU) so the emulator was restarted. (b),(c) look like emulator load, (a) was the app not answering. STATUS FAIL per brief (hang answering my action): the time-picker dial tap got no response for 5 s ('Input dispatching timed out'); host load was ~15 and guest load ~6, below the brief's 30. The functional results above (alarm cancelled on delete, moved on edit, no stray alert) passed.
